name: comp-271
blurb: Inline success alert with green icon.
description: Minimal inline alert for success messages using a green checkmark icon. Provides lightweight confirmation feedback without visual border.
use_when: Confirming successful form submission, action completion, or positive feedback without overwhelming the user.
avoid_when: When more visual prominence is needed. Dense layouts where inline styling is insufficient.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden. Parent should add role='status' or 'alert' and aria-live for screen reader announcements.
